articles.title: Codifying the Judge: Scalable Evaluation via Program Distillation
articles.description:
arXiv:2607.22561v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: LLM-as-a-judge has become the standard for automated evaluation, but it suffers from high cost, significant latency, and opaque decisions -- limitations that undermine its scalability and reliability. We address these with a simple, efficient alternative: program distillation. articles.title: SF-AMS: Strategic Forgetting for Structured Memory in LLM Agent
articles.description:

articles.title: Synthetic Scenario Generation for Evaluation of Industry 4.0 Agents
articles.description:
arXiv:2607.22563v1 Announce Type: new

articles.title: Same Question, Different Answers: Evaluating LLM Reliability Beyond Accuracy
articles.description:
arXiv:2607.22554v1 Announce Type: new

articles.title: Loss-Aware Feature-Map Pruning in Convolutional Neural Networks Using Multi-Armed Bandits
articles.description:
arXiv:2607.22564v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Convolutional neural networks often contain redundant feature maps that increase storage and inference cost. This paper presents a loss-aware feature-map pruning framework using multi-armed bandits. Feature-map pruning is structured because it removes complete convolutional output channels and their producing filters rather than isolated scalar weights. articles.title: Keyword Matters: Unveiling the Energy Sensitivity of On-Device LLM Prompting
articles.description:
